name: UP Police Constable
fullName: Uttar Pradesh Police Constable Recruitment (Civil Police, PAC, SSF, Jail Warder)
conductingBody: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB)
approxCandidates: ≈48 lakh applied in 2024 (60,244 posts); ≈32–33 lakh applicants reported for the 2025–26 drive (32,679 posts)
eligibility: Class 12 (Intermediate) pass; age limits vary by gender and category (age relaxation announced for the 2025–26 drive) – check the official notice

notification.summary: Advt. PRPB-B 07/2025 for 32,679 posts (Constable Civil Police, PAC, SSF and Jail Warder) was notified on 31 Dec 2025. The written exam was held on 8–10 June 2026 and the written result was declared on 31 July 2026 with 76,184 candidates shortlisted for DV/PST; physical tests are under way. Dates for DV/PST/PET were taken from news reports – confirm on uppbpb.gov.in.

pattern.notes: Bilingual paper (Hindi/English). Each section has a qualifying minimum of 35% (general) in the written exam as per recent notices. The written exam is followed by DV, PST, PET (4.8 km run) and medical. Section-wise counts follow the 2024 and 2026 papers (approximately 37–38 per section).

trendAnalysis.summary: Analysis of the 2018–19 paper, the Aug-2024 re-exam and the June-2026 exam. The paper is moderate overall: General Hindi and Numerical Ability are scoring, while GK is the deciding section, with a heavy UP-specific component (districts, rivers, national parks, schemes) and current affairs from the preceding 12 months. Reasoning has shifted towards verbal reasoning plus 'mental aptitude' questions on police duties, public interest and the law-and-order situation. Arithmetic stays at Class 10 level, with percentage, profit-loss, interest, time-work and speed being the high-yield topics. Negative marking (−0.5) has made accuracy more important since 2024.

pyqBlueprint.method: Compiled from memory-based shift-wise paper reconstructions and post-exam analyses of the Jan-2019 (2018 drive), Aug-2024 re-exam and 8–10 Jun 2026 papers published by coaching portals (Careerpower, PW, Prepp, TrueJobs; found via web search, Oct 2026) plus the writer's own knowledge of these papers. Official booklets/answer keys are taken down by UPPRPB after the objection window and the full papers could not be fetched, so patterns are described from these analyses and from memory; frequencies are approximate per paper.

archetypes.pattern: Modern India one-liner: who founded/presided over an organisation or in which year/session an event happened; distractors are contemporaries or nearby years/sessions
Ancient/medieval India: ruler–battle, dynasty–founder or ruler–monument match; distractors from the same dynasty or era
Freedom-struggle movement linked to a leader, slogan or place; distractors are other movements of the same decade
Which Article of the Constitution deals with a named right/provision; options are nearby or commonly confused Article numbers
Constitutional office/body: qualification age, term, oath or appointing authority; distractors swap related offices or ages
Schedules, amendments and borrowed features of the Constitution (e.g. which amendment added X, which schedule lists Y)
Indian rivers: nickname, origin point or tributary; distractors are other peninsular/Himalayan rivers or their sources
Physical geography of India/world: straits, passes, latitudes, soils and crops; distractors are neighbouring features
RBI, banking and monetary terms (repo rate, who issues notes, headquarters); distractors are other regulators/ministries
Government schemes, taxes and planning bodies: launch year, purpose or what replaced what; distractors are years/schemes close by
Chemistry: chemical formula or common name of everyday compounds (baking/washing soda, bleaching powder, plaster of Paris)
Biology: vitamin/mineral deficiency diseases and human-body facts; distractors are diseases of other deficiencies
Physics: SI units and everyday phenomena; distractors are units of related quantities
District in which a UP national park, sanctuary, fort or monument is located; distractors are neighbouring districts of the same region
UP city known for an industry or nickname (carpet, glass, brass, locks, ODOP); distractors are other UP industrial towns
UP history, culture and state symbols: freedom-struggle events in UP districts, state bird/animal/flower, folk arts
UP geography and administration: rivers, Ramsar sites, number of districts/divisions, bordering states
Major national event of the previous 12–18 months (mega events, military operations, missions); distractors are earlier events of the same kind
Sports: winner/runner-up or venue of a major tournament held in the previous year
Appointments to top constitutional posts and awards in the previous year; distractors are predecessors in the same post
Computer basics: input/output devices, full forms (URL, CPU, RAM), shortcuts
Static GK: books–authors, headquarters, important days, firsts
Choose the पर्यायवाची of a tatsam word; distractors are synonyms of look-alike words (अनल/अनिल, नीर/नीरद)
Which word is NOT a synonym of the given word; the odd option is a synonym of a related word (sun vs moon)
Choose the विलोम of a word; distractors are its own synonyms or prefix-confusions (कृतज्ञ/कृतघ्न)
Correct संधि-विच्छेद of a word; distractors split at the wrong place or use the wrong vowel
Name the type of संधि (दीर्घ/गुण/वृद्धि/यण/अयादि) in a given word
Identify the समास in a compound word (द्विगु/द्वंद्व/तत्पुरुष/अव्ययीभाव/कर्मधारय/बहुव्रीहि)
Correct समास-विग्रह of a compound; distractors use the wrong case-marker
Meaning of a मुहावरा; distractors are literal readings of its words
Meaning of a लोकोक्ति; distractors are moral-sounding but wrong paraphrases

archetypes.topic: One-word Substitution (वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द)
archetypes.pattern: One word for a phrase; distractors are near-meaning or opposite words (आस्तिक/नास्तिक)
Give the तद्भव of a तत्सम (or vice versa); distractors are tatsam synonyms of the same word
Choose the शुद्ध वर्तनी among four spellings differing in matra, ref or conjunct
Choose the grammatically correct sentence (लिंग/वचन/कारक errors in the others)
Author of a well-known Hindi work (novel, epic, poem collection); distractors are writers of the same period
उपनाम or literary period (काल) of a Hindi poet/writer
स्थायी भाव of a रस or the रस of a described feeling
Identify the अलंकार in a classic line (अनुप्रास/यमक/श्लेष/उपमा/रूपक)
Which given number is divisible by 11/8/9 etc.; options differ only in one digit
Unit digit of a power or product using the cyclicity of the last digit
BODMAS simplification with ÷ and × in sequence; distractors come from doing operations left-to-right incorrectly
Square roots, fractions or approximate value of a decimal expression
Successive or compensating percentage change (price rise vs consumption cut, +x% then −x%)
Comparison percentage: A is x% more than B, by how much is B less than A; percentage of a quantity
Profit/loss % from CP and SP, including 'buy m for ₹x, sell n for ₹y' items
Marked price and discount: SP after discount or discount % from MP and SP
Simple interest/rate/time from SI = PRT/100
Compound interest for 2 years or CI − SI difference for 2 years
Divide an amount in a given ratio of 2 or 3 parts
Compound ratio A:B and B:C to A:C or A:B:C
Average after removing/adding/replacing a member (team, class, captain)
Average of consecutive or first n natural/even/odd numbers
Two workers together or one worker alone from combined time (1/a ± 1/b)
Pipes and cisterns or a worker leaving midway
km/h ↔ m/s conversion and train crossing a pole/platform
Average speed for equal distances or relative speed of two objects
Area/perimeter of circle, rectangle, square or triangle with π = 22/7
Volume/surface area of cube, cuboid or cylinder
LCM/HCF of numbers or use of HCF × LCM = product of two numbers
Present age from ratio/multiple of ages now and after/before n years
Consecutive numbers/sum–difference puzzles
Word analogy based on worker–workplace, tool–user or object–function
Number analogy based on square/cube or n² ± 1 relation
Odd one out among four words of one category (animals, weapons, instruments)
Odd number out (prime/composite, multiples, squares)
Number series with ×2+1, increasing differences or n²+n patterns
Letter series with increasing gaps (+1, +2, +3 …)
Letter-shift coding (each letter ±1/±2); find the code of a new word
Numeric coding by sum/product of alphabet positions
Pointing/introduction statement ('his mother is the only daughter of my mother'); answer a single relation
Chain of relations among A, B, C, D; find the relation of two of them
Walk with left/right turns; final distance (often Pythagorean) and direction from start
Position from the other end or total persons in a row from two positions
Two statements, two conclusions (All/Some/No); choose which follow
Day of the week after a year/date shift using odd days
Angle between the hands of a clock at a given time
Arrange words/steps in a meaningful logical order (often police or civic procedure)
Situational judgement on a constable's duty (lost child, complaint at wrong police station, accident victim); best lawful and humane action
Law-and-order/public-interest situation (crowd, rumour, women's safety); choose the balanced action over force or inaction
Linear seating of 5 persons with 3–4 clues; identify who sits at a position

resources.notes: UPPRPB publishes provisional and final answer keys (with series-wise question booklets for objection) on uppbpb.gov.in shortly after each written exam; they are removed after the objection window, so previous papers are usually found via coaching compilations. No official mock test is provided.

questions.question: Who founded the Indian National Congress in 1885?
questions.questionHi: 1885 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की स्थापना किसने की थी?
questions.explanation: Allan Octavian Hume, a retired British civil servant, founded the INC in 1885; W. C. Bonnerjee presided over its first session in Bombay.

questions.question: In which year was the Battle of Plassey fought?
questions.questionHi: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Plassey (23 June 1757) was fought between Robert Clive and Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah. 1764 is Buxar, 1761 is the Third Battle of Panipat.

questions.question: The Chauri Chaura incident of 1922, after which Gandhiji withdrew the Non-Cooperation Movement, took place in which present-day district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: 1922 की चौरी-चौरा घटना, जिसके बाद गांधीजी ने असहयोग आंदोलन वापस लिया, वर्तमान उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में हुई थी?
questions.explanation: Chauri Chaura is in Gorakhpur district. The burning of the police station there on 5 February 1922 led Gandhiji to call off the movement.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता का उन्मूलन करता है?
questions.explanation: Article 17 abolishes untouchability. Article 14 is equality before law, 21 is right to life and 32 is constitutional remedies.

questions.question: What is the minimum age required to become a member of the Lok Sabha?
questions.questionHi: लोकसभा का सदस्य बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Article 84 fixes 25 years for the Lok Sabha (30 years for the Rajya Sabha).

questions.question: Which river is popularly known as the 'Dakshin Ganga'?
questions.questionHi: किस नदी को 'दक्षिण गंगा' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Godavari, the longest river of peninsular India, is called the Dakshin Ganga (Ganga of the South).

questions.question: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is famous worldwide as the 'Carpet City' of India?
questions.questionHi: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शहर भारत की 'कालीन नगरी' के रूप में विश्व-प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Bhadohi is the hub of hand-knotted carpets. Firozabad is known for glass bangles, Moradabad for brassware and Aligarh for locks.

questions.question: Dudhwa National Park is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: दुधवा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Dudhwa National Park lies in Lakhimpur Kheri district on the Indo-Nepal border. Bahraich has Katarniaghat and Pilibhit has a separate tiger reserve.

questions.question: The historic Kalinjar Fort is situated in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: ऐतिहासिक कालिंजर किला उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Kalinjar Fort stands in Banda district in the Bundelkhand region.

questions.question: Which institution decides the repo rate in India?
questions.questionHi: भारत में रेपो दर का निर्धारण कौन-सी संस्था करती है?
questions.explanation: The repo rate is set by the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of baking soda?
questions.questionHi: खाने के सोडे (बेकिंग सोडा) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation: Baking soda is sodium hydrogen carbonate, NaHCO₃. Na₂CO₃ is washing soda and CaCO₃ is limestone.

questions.question: Deficiency of Vitamin C causes which disease?
questions.questionHi: विटामिन C की कमी से कौन-सा रोग होता है?
questions.explanation: Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy. Rickets is due to Vitamin D, night blindness to Vitamin A and beriberi to Vitamin B1.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.questionHi: बल का SI मात्रक क्या है?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (kg·m/s²). Joule is the unit of work, watt of power and pascal of pressure.

questions.question: The Maha Kumbh Mela of 2025 was organised in which city?
questions.questionHi: वर्ष 2025 का महाकुंभ मेला किस शहर में आयोजित किया गया था?
questions.explanation: The Maha Kumbh 2025 (13 Jan – 26 Feb 2025) was held at the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: Which of the following is an input device of a computer?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कंप्यूटर का इनपुट डिवाइस है?
questions.explanation: A keyboard sends data into the computer; monitor, printer and speaker are output devices.

questions.question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'अग्नि'.
questions.questionHi: 'अग्नि' का पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: अनल = अग्नि। अनिल = हवा, नीर = जल, अंबर = आकाश।

questions.question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'कमल'.
questions.questionHi: 'कमल' का पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: पंकज (कीचड़ में जन्मा) = कमल। जलद और नीरद = बादल, पावक = आग।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'उत्थान'.
questions.questionHi: 'उत्थान' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: उत्थान (ऊपर उठना) का विलोम पतन है; अन्य तीनों उत्थान के समानार्थी हैं।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'मौखिक'.
questions.questionHi: 'मौखिक' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: मौखिक (मुख से कहा गया) का विलोम लिखित है।

questions.question: What is the correct sandhi-vichchhed (संधि-विच्छेद) of 'विद्यालय'?
questions.questionHi: 'विद्यालय' का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation: विद्या + आलय: आ + आ = आ (दीर्घ संधि) → विद्यालय।

questions.question: 'सूर्योदय' (सूर्य + उदय) में कौन-सी संधि है? (Which sandhi is in 'सूर्योदय'?)
questions.questionHi: 'सूर्योदय' (सूर्य + उदय) में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.explanation: अ + उ = ओ होता है, जो गुण संधि का नियम है।

questions.question: Which samas (समास) is used in 'चौराहा'?
questions.questionHi: 'चौराहा' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: चौराहा = चार राहों का समाहार; पहला पद संख्यावाचक है, अतः द्विगु समास।

questions.question: Which samas (समास) is used in 'यथाशक्ति'?
questions.questionHi: 'यथाशक्ति' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: यथाशक्ति = शक्ति के अनुसार; पहला पद 'यथा' अव्यय है और पूरा पद अव्यय की तरह प्रयुक्त होता है, अतः अव्ययीभाव समास।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना'?
questions.questionHi: मुहावरे 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'नौ दो ग्यारह होना' का अर्थ है चुपचाप भाग जाना। उदाहरण: पुलिस को देखते ही चोर नौ दो ग्यारह हो गया।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the proverb 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय'?
options: अधूरा काम सदा हानि करता है
कम ज्ञान वाला अधिक दिखावा करता है
questions.questionHi: लोकोक्ति 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionsHi: अधूरा काम सदा हानि करता है
कम ज्ञान वाला अधिक दिखावा करता है
questions.explanation: आधी भरी गगरी छलकती है, वैसे ही अल्पज्ञ व्यक्ति अपने थोड़े ज्ञान का अधिक प्रदर्शन करता है।

questions.topic: One-word Substitution (वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द)
questions.question: One word for 'जिसका कोई शत्रु न जन्मा हो':
questions.questionHi: 'जिसका कोई शत्रु न जन्मा हो' के लिए एक शब्द:
questions.explanation: अजातशत्रु = जिसका कोई शत्रु पैदा ही न हुआ हो। अजेय = जिसे जीता न जा सके, शत्रुघ्न = शत्रु का नाश करने वाला।

questions.question: Which is the tadbhav (तद्भव) form of the tatsam word 'सूर्य'?
questions.questionHi: तत्सम शब्द 'सूर्य' का तद्भव रूप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: सूर्य → सूरज (तद्भव)। रवि, दिनकर, भानु सूर्य के तत्सम पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word (शुद्ध वर्तनी).
questions.questionHi: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: शुद्ध रूप 'उज्ज्वल' है (उद् + ज्वल → उज्ज्वल), जिसमें 'ज्' के बाद 'ज्व' आता है।

questions.question: Who wrote the novel 'गोदान'?
questions.questionHi: 'गोदान' उपन्यास के लेखक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'गोदान' (1936) मुंशी प्रेमचंद का अंतिम पूर्ण उपन्यास है।

questions.question: What is the sthayi bhav (स्थायी भाव) of Veer Ras (वीर रस)?
questions.questionHi: वीर रस का स्थायी भाव क्या है?
questions.explanation: वीर रस का स्थायी भाव उत्साह है। क्रोध रौद्र रस का, रति श्रृंगार का और शोक करुण रस का स्थायी भाव है।

questions.question: A number is first increased by 20% and then the result is decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.questionHi: किसी संख्या में पहले 20% की वृद्धि की जाती है और फिर परिणाम में 20% की कमी की जाती है। कुल परिवर्तन कितना है?
questions.explanation: 100 → 120 → 120 × 0.8 = 96, so there is a net decrease of 4%.

questions.question: An article bought for ₹400 is sold for ₹460. What is the profit percentage?
questions.questionHi: ₹400 में खरीदी गई एक वस्तु ₹460 में बेची जाती है। लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?

questions.question: What is the simple interest on ₹5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years?
questions.questionHi: ₹5,000 पर 8% वार्षिक दर से 3 वर्ष का साधारण ब्याज कितना होगा?

questions.question: What is the compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?
questions.questionHi: ₹10,000 पर 10% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (वार्षिक संयोजन) कितना होगा?

questions.question: ₹1,800 is divided between two persons in the ratio 4 : 5. What is the larger share?
questions.questionHi: ₹1,800 को दो व्यक्तियों में 4 : 5 के अनुपात में बाँटा जाता है। बड़ा हिस्सा कितना है?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 9; one part = 1800/9 = ₹200; larger share = 5 × 200 = ₹1,000.

questions.question: What is the average of the first 10 natural numbers?
questions.questionHi: प्रथम 10 प्राकृत संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?

questions.question: The average of 5 numbers is 24. If one number is removed, the average of the remaining numbers becomes 22. Which number was removed?
questions.questionHi: 5 संख्याओं का औसत 24 है। एक संख्या हटाने पर शेष संख्याओं का औसत 22 हो जाता है। हटाई गई संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: Total of 5 numbers = 120; total of 4 numbers = 88; removed number = 120 − 88 = 32.

questions.question: A can finish a work in 12 days and B in 18 days. In how many days can they finish it working together?
questions.questionHi: A किसी काम को 12 दिनों में और B 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। दोनों मिलकर उसे कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: Combined work per day = 1/12 + 1/18 = 3/36 + 2/36 = 5/36; time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.question: A speed of 72 km/h is equal to how many metres per second?
questions.questionHi: 72 किमी/घंटा की चाल कितने मीटर/सेकंड के बराबर है?

questions.question: A train 150 m long is running at 54 km/h. How long will it take to cross a signal pole?
questions.questionHi: 150 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन 54 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। वह एक सिग्नल खंभे को कितने समय में पार करेगी?
questions.explanation: 54 km/h = 15 m/s; time = 150 / 15 = 10 seconds.

questions.question: What is the area of a circle of radius 7 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.questionHi: 7 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.explanation: Area = πr² = 22/7 × 7 × 7 = 154 cm². (44 cm is the circumference.)

questions.question: What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 30?
questions.questionHi: 12, 18 और 30 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) क्या है?

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या 11 से विभाज्य है?
questions.explanation: Test for 11: alternate digit sum difference. 2849 → (2+4) − (8+9) = −11, divisible (2849 = 11 × 259). The others give −2, −12 and −9.

questions.question: Simplify: 25 × 4 ÷ 5 + 6 − 3
A father is three times as old as his son. After 10 years, he will be twice as old as his son. What is the father's present age?
questions.questionHi: पिता की आयु पुत्र की आयु की तीन गुनी है। 10 वर्ष बाद पिता की आयु पुत्र की आयु की दोगुनी हो जाएगी। पिता की वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Let the son be x. 3x + 10 = 2(x + 10) ⇒ x = 10, so the father is 30 years old.

questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.questionHi: डॉक्टर : अस्पताल :: शिक्षक : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

questions.question: Find the odd one out.
questions.questionHi: विषम को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Lion, tiger and leopard are carnivorous big cats; the cow is a herbivore.

questions.question: Find the odd number out.
questions.questionHi: विषम संख्या चुनिए।
questions.explanation: 17, 19 and 23 are prime numbers; 27 = 3 × 9 is not.

questions.question: Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12: 30 + 12 = 42. (Each term is n(n+1).)

questions.question: Find the next letter: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.questionHi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.explanation: Positions 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 increase by 2, 3, 4, 5; next is 15 + 6 = 21 = U.

questions.question: If POLICE is coded as QPMJDF, how will THANA be coded?
questions.questionHi: यदि POLICE को QPMJDF लिखा जाता है, तो THANA को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one place forward: T→U, H→I, A→B, N→O, A→B, giving UIBOB.

questions.question: If CAT = 24 (sum of the alphabet positions of its letters), what is DOG?
questions.questionHi: यदि CAT = 24 (अक्षरों के वर्णमाला क्रमांकों का योग), तो DOG = ?

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Rita says, "He is the son of my paternal grandfather's only son." How is the man related to Rita?
questions.questionHi: एक व्यक्ति की ओर इशारा करते हुए रीता कहती है, "वह मेरे दादा के इकलौते पुत्र का पुत्र है।" वह व्यक्ति रीता का क्या लगता है?
questions.explanation: Rita's (paternal) grandfather's only son is Rita's father. The father's son is Rita's brother.

questions.question: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.questionHi: A, B की बहन है। C, B की माता है। D, C का पिता है। A का D से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A and B are children of C, and D is C's father. So A (a female) is D's granddaughter.

questions.question: Ram walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 5 km. Where is he now with respect to his starting point?
questions.questionHi: राम 5 किमी उत्तर चलता है, दाएँ मुड़कर 3 किमी चलता है, फिर दोबारा दाएँ मुड़कर 5 किमी चलता है। वह अपने आरंभिक बिंदु से कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: North 5 km, then right (east) 3 km, then right (south) 5 km. The north and south walks cancel, leaving him 3 km east of the start.

questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Mohan is 15th from the left end. What is his position from the right end?
questions.questionHi: 40 छात्रों की एक पंक्ति में मोहन बाएँ छोर से 15वें स्थान पर है। दाएँ छोर से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 40 − 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.question: If 1 January 2025 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was 1 January 2026?
questions.questionHi: यदि 1 जनवरी 2025 को बुधवार था, तो 1 जनवरी 2026 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not a leap year (365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day), so the day moves forward by one: Thursday.

questions.question: Statements: All constables are policemen. Some policemen are officers. Conclusions: I. Some policemen are constables. II. Some constables are officers. Which conclusion(s) follow?
questions.questionHi: कथन: सभी कांस्टेबल पुलिसकर्मी हैं। कुछ पुलिसकर्मी अधिकारी हैं। निष्कर्ष: I. कुछ पुलिसकर्मी कांस्टेबल हैं। II. कुछ कांस्टेबल अधिकारी हैं। कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं?
optionsHi: न तो I और न ही II
questions.explanation: 'All constables are policemen' converts to 'Some policemen are constables', so I follows. The officers may lie outside the constable group, so II does not necessarily follow.

questions.question: While on patrol, a constable finds a lost child crying in a crowded market. What is the most appropriate action?
options: Leave the child with a nearby shopkeeper and continue patrolling
Ignore the matter because no crime has been committed
Hand the child to the first person who claims to know him
Keep the child safe, comfort him and try to trace the guardians while informing the control room
questions.questionHi: गश्त के दौरान एक कांस्टेबल को भीड़ भरे बाज़ार में एक खोया हुआ बच्चा रोता हुआ मिलता है। सबसे उचित कार्य क्या है?
optionsHi: बच्चे को पास के दुकानदार के पास छोड़कर गश्त जारी रखना
कोई अपराध नहीं हुआ है, इसलिए मामले को अनदेखा करना
बच्चे को पहचानने का दावा करने वाले पहले व्यक्ति को सौंप देना
बच्चे को सुरक्षित रखकर ढाढ़स बँधाना और कंट्रोल रूम को सूचित करते हुए अभिभावकों की तलाश करना
questions.explanation: A police officer must ensure the child's safety and reunite the child with verified guardians, using announcements and the control room. The other actions put the child at risk.

questions.question: At which session of the Indian National Congress was the 'Purna Swaraj' (complete independence) resolution passed in 1929?
questions.questionHi: 1929 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का प्रस्ताव पारित किया गया था?
questions.explanation: The Lahore session of December 1929, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru, adopted the Purna Swaraj resolution; 26 January 1930 was then observed as Independence Day.

questions.question: The First Battle of Panipat (1526) was fought between Babur and which ruler?
questions.questionHi: पानीपत का प्रथम युद्ध (1526) बाबर और किस शासक के बीच लड़ा गया था?
questions.explanation: In 1526 Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi, the last Delhi Sultan, at Panipat. Rana Sanga fought Babur at Khanwa (1527); Hemu fought in the Second Battle of Panipat (1556).

questions.question: The Right to Constitutional Remedies is provided under which Article of the Indian Constitution?
questions.questionHi: संवैधानिक उपचारों का अधिकार भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत दिया गया है?
questions.explanation: Article 32 lets a person move the Supreme Court directly to enforce Fundamental Rights; Dr. B. R. Ambedkar called it the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution. Article 226 gives writ power to High Courts but is not a Fundamental Right.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
options: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.questionHi: भारत के राष्ट्रपति को पद की शपथ कौन दिलाता है?
questions.explanation: Under Article 60, the President takes the oath before the Chief Justice of India (or, in his absence, the senior-most Supreme Court judge).

questions.question: The river Narmada originates from which place?
questions.questionHi: नर्मदा नदी का उद्गम किस स्थान से होता है?
questions.explanation: The Narmada rises at Amarkantak (Anuppur district, Madhya Pradesh). Krishna rises near Mahabaleshwar, Kaveri at Brahmagiri and Tapti near Multai.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सा जलडमरूमध्य भारत को श्रीलंका से अलग करता है?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait lies between Tamil Nadu and the northern tip of Sri Lanka.

questions.question: In which year was the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana launched?
questions.questionHi: प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
questions.explanation: PMJDY, the financial-inclusion scheme for zero-balance bank accounts, was launched on 28 August 2014.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of washing soda?
questions.questionHi: धोने के सोडे (वाशिंग सोडा) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
questions.explanation: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate, Na₂CO₃·10H₂O. NaHCO₃ is baking soda, CaOCl₂ is bleaching powder and NaOH is caustic soda.

questions.question: Deficiency of iodine in the diet causes which disease?
questions.questionHi: आहार में आयोडीन की कमी से कौन-सा रोग होता है?
questions.explanation: Iodine is needed to make thyroid hormones; its deficiency enlarges the thyroid gland (goitre). Anaemia is linked to iron, rickets to vitamin D and scurvy to vitamin C.

questions.question: The Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary (Shaheed Chandra Shekhar Azad Bird Sanctuary) is located in which district of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: नवाबगंज पक्षी विहार (शहीद चंद्रशेखर आज़ाद पक्षी विहार) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
questions.explanation: Nawabganj Bird Sanctuary lies on the Lucknow–Kanpur highway in Unnao district; it is also a Ramsar site.

questions.question: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is known as the 'Brass City' (पीतल नगरी)?
questions.questionHi: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा शहर 'पीतल नगरी' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Moradabad is famous for brassware. Firozabad is known for glass bangles, Aligarh for locks and Bhadohi for carpets.

questions.question: Which is the state bird of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.questionHi: उत्तर प्रदेश का राजकीय पक्षी कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Sarus crane is the state bird of Uttar Pradesh; the state animal is the Barasingha (swamp deer). The house sparrow is Bihar's state bird and the peacock is India's national bird.

questions.question: India won the ICC Women's Cricket World Cup 2025 by defeating which team in the final?
questions.questionHi: भारत ने ICC महिला क्रिकेट विश्व कप 2025 के फाइनल में किस टीम को हराकर खिताब जीता?
questions.explanation: In the final at Navi Mumbai on 2 November 2025, India beat South Africa to win their first Women's ODI World Cup title.

questions.question: Who took oath as the 53rd Chief Justice of India in November 2025?
questions.questionHi: नवंबर 2025 में भारत के 53वें मुख्य न्यायाधीश के रूप में किसने शपथ ली?
questions.explanation: Justice Surya Kant became the 53rd CJI on 24 November 2025, succeeding Justice B. R. Gavai (52nd CJI); Justice Sanjiv Khanna was the 51st.

questions.question: What is the full form of 'URL' in computing?
questions.questionHi: कंप्यूटर में 'URL' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
questions.explanation: URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator – the address of a resource on the internet.

questions.question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'जल'.
questions.questionHi: 'जल' का पर्यायवाची शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: नीर, वारि, सलिल, तोय – ये 'जल' के पर्यायवाची हैं। अनल = आग, पवन = हवा, अंबर = आकाश।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'सूर्य'?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'सूर्य' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation: दिनकर, भास्कर और रवि 'सूर्य' के पर्यायवाची हैं; 'सुधांशु' (सुधा + अंशु) चंद्रमा का पर्यायवाची है।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'आशा'.
questions.questionHi: 'आशा' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: 'आशा' का विलोम 'निराशा' है; अभिलाषा, इच्छा और आकांक्षा तो इसके समानार्थी हैं।

questions.question: Choose the antonym (विलोम) of 'कृतज्ञ'.
questions.questionHi: 'कृतज्ञ' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: कृतज्ञ = उपकार मानने वाला; इसका विलोम कृतघ्न = उपकार न मानने वाला। 'आभारी' समानार्थी है।

questions.question: What is the correct sandhi-vichchhed (संधि-विच्छेद) of 'नयन'?
questions.questionHi: 'नयन' का सही संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation: ए + अ = अय (अयादि संधि): ने + अन = नयन।

questions.question: 'सदैव' (सदा + एव) में कौन-सी संधि है? (Which sandhi is in 'सदैव'?)
questions.questionHi: 'सदैव' (सदा + एव) में कौन-सी संधि है?
questions.explanation: आ + ए = ऐ होता है, जो वृद्धि संधि का नियम है: सदा + एव = सदैव।

questions.question: Which samas (समास) is used in 'माता-पिता'?
questions.questionHi: 'माता-पिता' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: माता-पिता = माता और पिता; दोनों पद प्रधान हैं और 'और' से जुड़े हैं, अतः द्वंद्व समास।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the idiom 'अंगूठा दिखाना'?
questions.questionHi: मुहावरे 'अंगूठा दिखाना' का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'अंगूठा दिखाना' का अर्थ है समय पर साफ़ मना कर देना। अन्य विकल्प शब्दों के शाब्दिक अर्थ पर आधारित हैं।

questions.question: What is the meaning of the proverb 'नाच न जाने आँगन टेढ़ा'?
options: अपनी अयोग्यता का दोष दूसरों पर डालना
घर का आँगन ठीक कराना चाहिए
questions.questionHi: लोकोक्ति 'नाच न जाने आँगन टेढ़ा' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionsHi: अपनी अयोग्यता का दोष दूसरों पर डालना
घर का आँगन ठीक कराना चाहिए
questions.explanation: जो व्यक्ति स्वयं काम न जानता हो और कमी साधनों या दूसरों में बताए, उसके लिए यह लोकोक्ति कही जाती है।

questions.topic: One-word Substitution (वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द)
questions.question: One word for 'जो ईश्वर में विश्वास रखता हो':
questions.questionHi: 'जो ईश्वर में विश्वास रखता हो' के लिए एक शब्द:
questions.explanation: ईश्वर में विश्वास रखने वाला 'आस्तिक' कहलाता है; विश्वास न रखने वाला 'नास्तिक'।

questions.question: Which is the tadbhav (तद्भव) form of the tatsam word 'अग्नि'?
questions.questionHi: तत्सम शब्द 'अग्नि' का तद्भव रूप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: 'अग्नि' का तद्भव रूप 'आग' है। अनल, पावक और वह्नि तो अग्नि के तत्सम पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word (शुद्ध वर्तनी).
questions.questionHi: शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
questions.explanation: शुद्ध रूप 'आशीर्वाद' (आशीः + वाद) है – 'शी' में दीर्घ ई और 'र्' का रेफ 'वा' पर लगता है।

questions.question: Who wrote 'रामचरितमानस'?
questions.questionHi: 'रामचरितमानस' के रचयिता कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: रामचरितमानस की रचना गोस्वामी तुलसीदास ने अवधी भाषा में की। सूरदास ने 'सूरसागर' और केशवदास ने 'रामचंद्रिका' लिखी।

questions.question: The pen-name (उपनाम) 'निराला' belongs to which poet?
questions.questionHi: 'निराला' किस कवि का उपनाम है?
questions.explanation: छायावादी कवि सूर्यकांत त्रिपाठी का उपनाम 'निराला' था। रामधारी सिंह का उपनाम 'दिनकर' था।

questions.question: Which alankar (अलंकार) is in the line 'चारु चंद्र की चंचल किरणें'?
questions.questionHi: 'चारु चंद्र की चंचल किरणें' में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: इस पंक्ति में 'च' वर्ण की बार-बार आवृत्ति है; वर्णों की आवृत्ति से अनुप्रास अलंकार होता है।

questions.question: What is the unit digit of 7²³?
questions.questionHi: 7²³ का इकाई अंक क्या है?
questions.explanation: Unit digits of powers of 7 repeat in the cycle 7, 9, 3, 1. 23 = 4 × 5 + 3, so the unit digit is the 3rd in the cycle: 3.

questions.question: Simplify: 48 ÷ 6 × 3 + 15 − 9
questions.explanation: ÷ and × are done left to right: 48 ÷ 6 = 8, 8 × 3 = 24; then 24 + 15 − 9 = 30.

questions.question: The price of sugar rises by 25%. By what percentage must a family reduce its consumption so that its expenditure on sugar remains the same?
questions.questionHi: चीनी का मूल्य 25% बढ़ जाता है। एक परिवार को अपनी खपत में कितने प्रतिशत की कमी करनी चाहिए ताकि चीनी पर उसका व्यय पहले जितना ही रहे?
questions.explanation: Required reduction = 25/(100 + 25) × 100 = 20%.

questions.question: A's salary is 20% more than B's salary. By what percentage is B's salary less than A's?
questions.questionHi: A का वेतन B के वेतन से 20% अधिक है। B का वेतन A के वेतन से कितने प्रतिशत कम है?
questions.explanation: Let B = 100, then A = 120. B is less by 20, i.e. 20/120 × 100 = 16⅔%.

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys pens at 5 for ₹40 and sells them at 4 for ₹40. What is his profit percentage?
questions.questionHi: एक दुकानदार ₹40 में 5 पेन खरीदता है और ₹40 में 4 पेन बेचता है। उसका लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?
questions.explanation: CP of one pen = ₹8, SP of one pen = ₹10. Profit = 2/8 × 100 = 25%.

questions.question: The marked price of a jacket is ₹1,200. If a discount of 15% is given, what is the selling price?
questions.questionHi: एक जैकेट का अंकित मूल्य ₹1,200 है। 15% की छूट देने पर विक्रय मूल्य क्या होगा?

questions.question: What is the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on ₹8,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum (compounded annually)?
questions.questionHi: ₹8,000 पर 5% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष के चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (वार्षिक संयोजन) और साधारण ब्याज का अंतर कितना है?

questions.question: ₹2,700 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. What is C's share?
questions.questionHi: ₹2,700 को A, B और C में 2 : 3 : 4 के अनुपात में बाँटा जाता है। C का हिस्सा कितना है?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 9; one part = 2,700 ÷ 9 = ₹300. C's share = 4 × 300 = ₹1,200.

questions.question: The average age of an 11-member team is 25 years. If the 35-year-old captain is excluded, what is the average age of the remaining players?
questions.questionHi: 11 सदस्यों वाली एक टीम की औसत आयु 25 वर्ष है। यदि 35 वर्षीय कप्तान को अलग कर दिया जाए, तो शेष खिलाड़ियों की औसत आयु कितनी होगी?
questions.explanation: Total age = 11 × 25 = 275. Without the captain: 275 − 35 = 240; average = 240 ÷ 10 = 24 years.

questions.question: A and B together can finish a work in 10 days, and A alone can finish it in 15 days. In how many days can B alone finish it?
questions.questionHi: A और B मिलकर किसी काम को 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं और A अकेला उसे 15 दिनों में। B अकेला उसे कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?
questions.explanation: B's one-day work = 1/10 − 1/15 = (3 − 2)/30 = 1/30, so B alone needs 30 days.

questions.question: A train 240 m long, running at 72 km/h, crosses a platform 160 m long. How much time does it take?
questions.questionHi: 72 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही 240 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन 160 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफ़ॉर्म को पार करती है। इसमें कितना समय लगेगा?

questions.question: What is the volume of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.questionHi: 7 सेमी त्रिज्या और 10 सेमी ऊँचाई वाले बेलन का आयतन क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें)

questions.question: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 180. If one of the numbers is 36, what is the other?
questions.questionHi: दो संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) 12 और लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) 180 है। यदि एक संख्या 36 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है?
questions.explanation: Product of the numbers = HCF × LCM = 12 × 180 = 2,160. Other number = 2,160 ÷ 36 = 60.

questions.question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 5 : 7. After 6 years, the ratio will be 3 : 4. What is A's present age?
questions.questionHi: A और B की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 5 : 7 है। 6 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 3 : 4 हो जाएगा। A की वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?

questions.question: The sum of three consecutive even numbers is 84. What is the largest of them?
questions.questionHi: तीन क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का योग 84 है। उनमें सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: Let the numbers be x − 2, x, x + 2. 3x = 84 → x = 28, so the numbers are 26, 28, 30; the largest is 30.

questions.question: Judge : Court :: Farmer : ?
questions.questionHi: न्यायाधीश : न्यायालय :: किसान : ?
questions.explanation: A judge works in a court; a farmer works in a field. Crop, tractor and plough are what he grows or uses, not where he works.

questions.question: Find the odd one out.
questions.questionHi: विषम को चुनिए।
questions.explanation: Rifle, pistol and revolver are firearms; a sword is a bladed weapon.

questions.question: Find the next number: 3, 7, 15, 31, 63, ?
questions.explanation: Each term = previous × 2 + 1: 63 × 2 + 1 = 127.

questions.question: Find the next letter: B, D, G, K, P, ?
questions.questionHi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: B, D, G, K, P, ?

questions.question: If BOOK is coded as ANNJ, how will LAMP be coded?
questions.questionHi: यदि BOOK को ANNJ लिखा जाता है, तो LAMP को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted one place back: L→K, A→Z, M→L, P→O, giving KZLO.

questions.question: Pointing to a woman, Amit said, "Her mother is the only daughter of my mother." How is the woman related to Amit?
questions.questionHi: एक महिला की ओर इशारा करते हुए अमित ने कहा, "इसकी माँ मेरी माँ की इकलौती पुत्री है।" वह महिला अमित की क्या लगती है?
questions.explanation: The only daughter of Amit's mother is Amit's sister. The woman's mother is Amit's sister, so the woman is Amit's niece (sister's daughter).

questions.question: Sita walks 6 km towards the south, turns left and walks 8 km. How far and in which direction is she now from her starting point?
questions.questionHi: सीता दक्षिण की ओर 6 किमी चलती है, बाएँ मुड़कर 8 किमी चलती है। वह अपने आरंभिक बिंदु से कितनी दूर और किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: Turning left while facing south means facing east. Distance = √(6² + 8²) = 10 km; she is to the south-east of the start.

questions.question: In a row of boys, Raju is 12th from the left end and 18th from the right end. How many boys are there in the row?
questions.questionHi: लड़कों की एक पंक्ति में राजू बाएँ छोर से 12वें और दाएँ छोर से 18वें स्थान पर है। पंक्ति में कुल कितने लड़के हैं?
questions.explanation: Total = 12 + 18 − 1 = 29 (Raju is counted twice).

questions.question: Statements: All guns are weapons. No weapon is a toy. Conclusions: I. No gun is a toy. II. Some weapons are guns. Which conclusion(s) follow?
questions.questionHi: कथन: सभी बंदूकें हथियार हैं। कोई हथियार खिलौना नहीं है। निष्कर्ष: I. कोई बंदूक खिलौना नहीं है। II. कुछ हथियार बंदूकें हैं। कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं?
optionsHi: न तो I और न ही II
questions.explanation: All guns lie inside weapons and no weapon is a toy, so no gun is a toy (I follows). 'All guns are weapons' implies 'some weapons are guns' (II follows).

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 4:20?
questions.questionHi: 4:20 बजे घड़ी की घंटे और मिनट की सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?

questions.question: Arrange in a meaningful order: 1. FIR  2. Crime  3. Investigation  4. Charge-sheet  5. Trial
questions.questionHi: सार्थक क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए: 1. एफ़आईआर  2. अपराध  3. जाँच  4. आरोप-पत्र  5. मुकदमा (विचारण)
questions.explanation: A crime is committed, an FIR is lodged, police investigate, a charge-sheet is filed in court and then the trial takes place.

questions.question: A woman comes to a police station to report a serious offence against her, but the incident took place in the area of another police station. What should the constable on duty do?
options: Ask her to come back the next day with a lawyer
Tell her to go to the police station of the area where the incident happened
Note her complaint in a personal diary and send her home
Ensure a Zero FIR is registered and the case is transferred to the police station concerned
questions.questionHi: एक महिला अपने विरुद्ध हुए गंभीर अपराध की शिकायत करने थाने आती है, परंतु घटना किसी दूसरे थाने के क्षेत्र में हुई है। ड्यूटी पर तैनात कांस्टेबल को क्या करना चाहिए?
optionsHi: उसे अगले दिन वकील के साथ आने को कहे
उसे घटना वाले क्षेत्र के थाने जाने के लिए कह दे
शिकायत अपनी निजी डायरी में लिखकर उसे घर भेज दे
सुनिश्चित करे कि ज़ीरो एफ़आईआर दर्ज हो और मामला संबंधित थाने को स्थानांतरित किया जाए
questions.explanation: For a cognizable offence the police must register the information even if it occurred outside their area (Zero FIR, Section 173 BNSS) and transfer it to the station concerned. Sending her away delays justice.

questions.question: During a festival procession, a rumour spreads on social media that could create communal tension. What is the most appropriate step for the police?
options: Stop the procession by force immediately
Inform senior officers, counter the rumour with verified information and act against those spreading it while keeping watch on the procession
Ignore it because rumours fade away on their own
Arrest everyone taking part in the procession
questions.questionHi: एक त्योहार के जुलूस के दौरान सोशल मीडिया पर एक अफ़वाह फैलती है जिससे सांप्रदायिक तनाव पैदा हो सकता है। पुलिस के लिए सबसे उचित कदम क्या है?
optionsHi: जुलूस को तुरंत बलपूर्वक रोक देना
वरिष्ठ अधिकारियों को सूचित करना, सत्यापित जानकारी से अफ़वाह का खंडन करना और जुलूस पर निगरानी रखते हुए अफ़वाह फैलाने वालों पर कार्रवाई करना
इसे अनदेखा करना क्योंकि अफ़वाहें अपने आप समाप्त हो जाती हैं
जुलूस में शामिल सभी लोगों को गिरफ़्तार कर लेना
questions.explanation: The balanced response is to alert seniors, publicise the facts, take legal action against rumour-mongers and maintain vigilance; force or inaction can worsen the situation.

questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. C sits in the middle. A sits immediately to the left of C. B sits at the right end. D sits immediately to the right of C. Who sits at the left end?
questions.questionHi: पाँच मित्र A, B, C, D और E उत्तर की ओर मुख करके एक पंक्ति में बैठे हैं। C बीच में बैठा है। A, C के ठीक बाएँ बैठा है। B दाएँ छोर पर बैठा है। D, C के ठीक दाएँ बैठा है। बाएँ छोर पर कौन बैठा है?
questions.explanation: Positions from left: 3 = C, 2 = A, 4 = D, 5 = B, so the remaining place 1 (left end) is E.
